chunks.heading: A Journey Into the Soul
chunks.notes: The chunk opens with the reframing question ("What if the human eye wasn't an organ, but a planet?") and establishes the clinical, cataloging register before describing the first biome (the skin desert) in worldbuilding-style detail.

chunks.heading: A Journey Into the Soul
chunks.notes: Continues the expedition's cataloging structure through two more biomes (the sclera sea, the iris forest), with creatures described as watching/reacting to the light-traveler, keeping the observer motif active.

chunks.heading: A Journey Into the Soul
chunks.notes: The descent into the pupil is rendered as a disorienting, gravity-defying threshold-crossing that culminates in the reveal of the Soullight, the chunk's clear turning point.

chunks.heading: A Journey Into the Soul
chunks.notes: The closing lines land the piece's point explicitly and aphoristically ("Every eye contains a universe... light is the only witness"), naming light itself as observer/witness rather than showing further action.
